meta.name: programmatic-seo
meta.description: Builds large sets of search-targeted pages from a template and a dataset — the location, comparison, integration, and use-case pages that capture long-tail demand at scale. Use this when there is a repeating query pattern with real volume, when a dataset could answer many similar searches, or to judge whether a programmatic approach is viable before building it.

copy.tagline: 批量生成搜索友好的网页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手握数据,想批量做出能获取搜索流量的网页
copy.tagline_en: Turn data into SEO-friendly pages at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have data and want to generate many pages that rank in search

howto.what: 该技能用于从模板和数据集批量生成面向搜索的网页（如位置页、对比页）。它要求先验证查询需求、数据质量和页面差异，再手工设计出样板页面，然后设置最低数据门槛、内部链接和分批发布，并定期维护和清理无效页面。
howto.when: 当查询有重复模式且带真实流量、当数据集能回答多个类似搜索、或当你想先评估程序化方案是否可行时，这个技能会被激活。

say.text: 我有全市各商家的数据，想生成每个区的对比页，帮我评估可行性。
say.note: Claude 会依据四个前提条件判断是否该做。

say.text: 请按这个模板生成500个页面，但先做一张样板给我确认。
say.note: Claude 会先设计出样板单页，再谈规模化。

say.text: 已发布200页，帮我分析收录和展示，决定要不要继续发。
say.note: Claude 会建议分批发布并处理无效页。

howto.what_en: Builds large sets of search-targeted pages from a template and a dataset. It first checks four criteria (real query volume, data quality, per-page value, edge), then designs a sample page, sets a data threshold, internal linking, batch rollout, and regular pruning.
howto.when_en: Activates when there is a repeating query pattern with real volume, when a dataset can answer many similar searches, or when you want to judge whether a programmatic approach is viable before building.

say_en.text: I have district business data. Generate comparison pages per district and assess feasibility.
Before generating 500 pages, create a sample page from this template for approval.
say_en.note: Claude starts with one hand-crafted page.

say_en.text: We published 200 pages. Analyze indexing and impressions to decide if we continue.
say_en.note: Claude advises batch rollout and removing weak pages.
